dialogues.text: Well, then you've come to the right place. Have a look, see if anything takes your fancy!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Welcome. Every treasure here is unique, so we don't negotiate on the price, nor do we give refunds.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Browse items.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Take a look around. Let me know if you're interested in any of these.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Browse items.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: My, this is unfortunate. The shop's been undergoing renovations recently.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Drop by next time. Our products will never disappoint!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your wares.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Which one caught your eye? Every item here is unique. Every purchase here is a bargain!

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: They were all purchased from the adventurers. Each of them represents the passion and courage of these adventurers—

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: So don't bother asking for a discount. You can never discount passion and courage!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you come to own this shop?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Why did I open this shop, you ask? It's because of my dad.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: He's the Master of the Adventurers' Guild, Mondstadt Branch. He always brings tons of treasures after each adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: He'll then tell me the story behind each of the treasures... He was my hero when I was little.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I wanted to share these stories with everyone, so I opened this shop—

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: But not long after opening, my dad became a bit more doddery and talks to himself all day...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did I hear you talk about Wolvendom?

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Oh, yes. I did see something strange in Wolvendom not long ago.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: From the silhouette, it seemed to be a boy, but he was with a pack of wolves, and they seemed very close, too...

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: Perhaps I was mistaken. I was quite a distance away, after all, and it was only a glimpse.

dialogues.speaker: Marjorie
dialogues.text: I mean, how could humans live alongside wolves? How strange...
